answer:
I opened `/home/hyoklee/cae_test_data/porotomo/dasv_native_PoroTomo_iDAS025_160318160317.h5` read-only, ran `hdf5_analyze_dataset_structure` on the root (which reads shapes and dtypes straight from the file), and cross-checked the root listing with `hdf5_list_keys`. The file has a flat root group — 8 datasets, no subgroups:

| Dataset | Shape | Dtype | Likely meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `das` | (30000, 384) | float32 | Main DAS strain-rate array: 30,000 time samples × 384 channels |
| `t` | (30000,) | float64 | Time axis for the 30,000 samples |
| `trace` | (30000,) | int64 | Trace/sample index |
| `channel` | (384,) | int32 | Channel numbers |
| `x` | (384,) | float32 | Channel x positions |
| `y` | (384,) | float32 | Channel y positions |
| `z` | (384,) | float32 | Channel z positions (depth) |
| `crs` | () (scalar) | uint8 | Coordinate reference system flag |

So the core measurement is `das` — 30,000 samples along 384 fiber channels, with `t` giving the time stamps and `x`/`y`/`z` the spatial coordinates of each channel; `crs` is a scalar flag. (The file also carries attributes, but two of them are ndarray/reference-valued and the attribute-listing tools couldn't serialize them, so I left attributes out rather than guess — the dataset shapes and dtypes above come directly from the file structure analysis.)
